items.name: CuBonn Open 2026
items.information:
Willkommen in der ehemaligen Hauptstadt – willkommen in Bonn!
Zum allerersten Mal bringt ein Cubing-Turnier die Würfel-Community in diese traditionsreiche Stadt – und wir sind bereit, Geschichte zu schreiben.

Freu dich auf ein Wochenende voller Spannung, persönlicher Bestzeiten, packender Finals und unvergesslicher Momente. Ob Newcomer oder Speedcubing-Profi – in Bonn wird gecubed, gefeiert und mitgefiebert!

Sei dabei, wenn das erste Turnier in Bonn legendär wird.
Melde dich jetzt an – wir können es kaum erwarten, dich dort zu sehen!

Welcome to the former capital – welcome to Bonn!
For the very first time, a cubing tournament is coming to this historic city – and we’re ready to make history together.

Get ready for a weekend full of excitement, personal bests, thrilling finals, and unforgettable moments. Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned speedcuber – in Bonn, we cube, we cheer, and we celebrate!

Baja Cubing presenta **FMC Tijuas II 2026**, una nueva oportunidad para desafiar tu análisis y precisión en el Fewest Moves Challenge. Vive una jornada enfocada en FMC y eventos silenciosos, donde cada movimiento cuenta y la estrategia marca la diferencia.

Baja Cubing proudly presents **FMC Tijuas II 2026**, another opportunity to test your analytical skills and precision in the Fewest Moves Challenge. Enjoy a competition focused on FMC and silent events, where efficiency and planning are key.

Take on the challenge, refine your solutions, and strive for maximum optimization.

**This competition does not include 3x3**

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

###### Español
¡Bienvenidos al UPEN Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de Nayarit!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 16 y domingo 17 de mayo de 2026.

El UPEN Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el[ reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

###### English
Welcome to UPEN Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 16, and Sunday, May 17, 2026.

UPEN Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun.

This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by  [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information:
🇧🇷 **Português**

**Bem-vindos à segunda competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!!**
Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica.
Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2026 promete a consolidação do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. 
Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo consolidar a representatividade também em um Esporte da Mente! 
Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento!
Nos vemos lá!

🇬🇧 **English:**

**Welcome to the second speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!!**
Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas.
Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions.
Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport  too!
Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event!
We will meet there!

items.name: Halkida Spring Open 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcwODMzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8353064ff996ef2d056815725f11f1ef2a0e7863/image.png)
Το Halkida Spring Open 2026 θα είναι ο επόμενος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2026 και ο πρώτος που γίνεται ποτέ στην πανέμορφη πόλη της Χαλκίδας!

Στη φιλόξενη και ευρύχωρη αίθουσα συνεδριάσεων του Lucy Hotel, παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο, θα συναντηθούμε ξανά για το αγαπημένο μας χόμπυ.
Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες.

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα.

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι:

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)
[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI)


The Halkida Spring Open 2026 will be our next official competition of 2026 and the first ever to be held in the beautiful city of Halkida!

In the welcoming conference hall of the Lucy Hotel, cubers from all over the country and beyond—young and old, new and experienced—will come together once again for our favorite hobby.
Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for another cubing celebration!

Please read the following tabs very carefully!

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

​
##### Español
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

¡Bienvenidos a **555 - Puebla 2026**!

Puebla se prepara para recibirte en un torneo que pondrá a prueba tu nivel.

**¿Estás listo para el desafío del 5x5?**

El nombre del torneo no es coincidencia. El 5x5 representa un reto que exige estrategia, precisión y concentración.

Así, el 5x5 se convierte en el corazón de este torneo, acompañado de otras categorías desafiantes.

Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**.

 **555 - Puebla 2026** es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).
​
AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

##### English
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Welcome to **555 - Puebla 2026**!

Puebla is ready to welcome you to a tournament that will test your level.

**Are you ready for the 5x5 challenge?**

The name of the tournament is no coincidence. The 5x5 represents a challenge that requires strategy, precision, and focus.

That’s why 5x5 becomes the heart of this tournament, accompanied by other challenging events.

This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**.

 **555 - Puebla 2026** is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

### 🇧🇷 Português
Campeonato Mineiro 2026, em parceria com a Associação Mineira de Cultura Nipo-Brasileira!
Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar.
Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir.

O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$50. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento.

Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para a modalidade 3x3x3.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

### 🇺🇸 English
Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate.
In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization.

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

The registration fee is R$50. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment.

Registrations on the spot will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event.

By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

Welcome to **Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026**.

This competition serves as the sequel to **[Greenwoods Clock Clash 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsClockClash2026)** and will feature **Clock** as the main event. Additional official events include **3×3, Megaminx, Skewb, 3x3 One-Handed (OH), 3x3 Fewest Moves (FMC), and 5×5 Blindfolded (5BLD)**.

The competition will also include the unofficial event **3×3 Team Blindfolded**. Participation in unofficial events is entirely optional and will not affect official competition results. Additional unofficial events, including **1×3×3 Floppy Cube** and **Magic**, are **tentative** and may be added depending on schedule availability and logistical considerations. Please refer to the **[Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsSummerOvertime2026#72726-unofficial-events-info-registration)** tab for further details.

All competitors and guests are encouraged to carefully review the information tabs on this page for details regarding the **competition schedule, event regulations, venue guidelines, and registration procedures**. Familiarizing yourself with this information will help ensure the competition runs smoothly and that all participants have an enjoyable experience.

We look forward to seeing you at **Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026**.

Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. items.name: German Open 2026
items.information:
In 2004, the first official German speedcubing competition was held: German Open 2004. The German Open have been held almost every year since and the German Open 2026 continue this traditional competition series! We would be happy if you'd join us and we hope you will enjoy the competition and have fun!

Im Jahr 2004 fand der erste offizielle deutsche Speedcubing-Wettbewerb statt: German Open 2004. Seitdem finden die German Open fast jedes Jahr statt und die German Open 2026 setzen diese traditionelle Wettbewerbsreihe fort! Wir würden uns freuen, wenn ihr dabei seid und wünschen viel Spaß und Freude am Wettbewerb!

# 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다.
# 멀티 블라인드: 선착순 20명만 참가 가능.
# [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70901-spectator-restriction)이 존재합니다.

WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70897-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70896-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

# There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition.
# MBLD: first 20 competitors only.
# There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70901-spectator-restriction).

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70897-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70896-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

##### *🎵"Bonito León, Guanajuato, la feria con su jugada, allí se apuesta la vida y se respeta al que gana..."🎶*

## Caminos de Guanajuato – León 2026

La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** comienza su recorrido en **León, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Este torneo forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo.
En cada parada, la música de José Alfredo Jiménez acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a León.

El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música.

Te esperamos en León para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

## Caminos de Guanajuato – León 2026

The "Caminos de Guanajuato" route begins in **León, Guanajuato**, a place that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and daily life intertwine in every corner. This tournament is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different locations under the same competitive and festive spirit.

At each stop, the music of José Alfredo Jiménez symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have given voice to the Guanajuato spirit, inspire this edition dedicated to León.

The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music.

We look forward to seeing you in León to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together.

This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by  [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information:
## VOLUNTEERING
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png)

A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. follow them on socials by scanning the QR Code below.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bea620be86f2f2e79b7ff56af3eef8d900240518/IMG_2596.jpg)

The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** have gracouisly offered us the venue at a very reduced rate as part of their support for the competition. Please continue to return the favour to them by supporting their restaurant and accomodation. Also follow the hotel on socials by scanning the QR code below.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--781305c69b42fd5cad23e5a76d3b2c4c6e2cd2f3/IMG_2595.jpg)

##Accommodation 

The hotel have offered discounted accommodation rates to our cubers (and guests) for the weekend of the competition. You can book your accomodation by sending an email to Penny Mbobo pmbobo@legacyhotels.co.za and mention the code "Rubiks 2026" when making your booking. Reach out to the competition organizers or delegates if you have more questions.



## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS
Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time.

## About CubingZA
CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.
If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.name: Dobřejovice Special 2026
items.information:
# ENGLISH

**Mandatory Competition tutorial**

All competitors are required to complete the official competitor tutorial before being allowed to participate in the competition. This requirement applies to everyone, not only newcomers.
Competitors who do not attend the tutorial will not be permitted to compete.

**Special Competition Format**

This competition will be held using a special format in which all events run simultaneously.
Each competitor will have a 45-minute cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose.


# ČESKY

**Povinný tutoriál pro soutěžící**

Všichni závodníci musí před začátkem soutěže absolvovat oficiální tutoriál. Tato povinnost platí pro všechny, nejen pro nováčky.
Závodníkům, kteří se tutoriálu nezúčastní, nebude umožněno soutěžit.

**Speciální formát soutěže**

Tato soutěž bude probíhat ve speciálním formátu, ve kterém všechny disciplíny běží zároveň.
Každý soutěžící má k dispozici 45 minut, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
​
**NYU ID POLICY:** New York University requires all adults to bring a government issued ID to sign in to NYU buildings. The organizers of this competition will have to submit a list of all visitors (which includes the competitor and their adult chaperone if the competitor is a minor) to the NYU visitor system after registration has been finalized. Read more about the [NYU Visitor Policy here](https://www.nyu.edu/about/visitor-information/sponsoring-visitors.html).
​
**MINORS POLICY:** New York University requires chaperones for all minors participating in on-campus events. Therefore, any child under 18 in the venue must be accompanied by a parent or other adult, who will be required to bring a government issued ID and sign in. 
​
**GUEST POLICY:** Each competitor is allowed to bring only 1 guest. If you would like to bring additional guests, please reach out to the organizers and we will let you know if there are any extra guest slots.
​
**NYU Students and Alumni:** NYU students and alumni will receive a full refund for their registration. Please provide your NYU email in the comments of your registration and a full refund will be initiated once your registration is accepted.

items.name: Teknostallen 2026
items.information:
### 🇳🇴 Teknostallen 2026

Gjør deg klar for en fin kubehelg når vi inviterer til konkurranse i Teknostallen i Trondheim 28.–29. mars! Dette blir en helg med ekte konkurransestemning, offisielle tider og masse energi. Arrangementet er for ALLE – enten du løser kuben på 3 sekunder eller 3 minutter, og enten du er 7 eller 70 år. Her skal både nybegynnere og erfarne speedcubers samles for å dele lidenskapen for kuben og jakten på nye personlige rekorder.

Konkurransen går over to dager inne i den spektakulære tropiske hagen i Teknostallen, en helt unik ramme for raske fingre og raske hoder. Det konkurreres i mange ulike grener, fra klassisk 3x3 til flere andre varianter. Dette blir en helg fylt med mestring, spenning og ekte kubeglede.

Man går inn hovedinngangen på Teknostallen, og venteområdet kommer til å være under messaninen, mens konkurransene foregår oppe på messaninen. Det er gode muligheter for å kjøpe både mat og drikke fra de ulike plassene på bygget som Mellom, Glød og Snurr. 

---

### 🇺🇸 Teknostallen 2026

Get ready for a great cube weekend as we invite you to a competition at Teknostallen in Trondheim on March 28–29. This will be a weekend filled with real competition atmosphere, official timing and plenty of energy. The event is for EVERYONE – whether you solve the cube in 3 seconds or 3 minutes, and whether you are 7 or 70 years old. Both beginners and experienced speedcubers will gather to share their passion for cubing and the pursuit of new personal bests.

The competition takes place over two days inside the spectacular tropical garden at Teknostallen, a truly unique setting for fast fingers and fast minds. Multiple events will be held, from the classic 3x3 to several other variations. Expect a weekend filled with achievement, excitement and true cube joy.

Enter through the main entrance of Teknostallen. The waiting area will be located under the mezzanine, while the competitions take place on the mezzanine level. There will be great opportunities to purchase food and drinks from the various venues in the building, including Mellom, Glød and Snurr.

items.information:
This competition holds only "Please Be Quiet" events - 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multiblind and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves Challenge. As the name suggests, it is crucial to maintain silence during all events. We'll have sufficient amount of breaks when it is ok to make some noise.

Эти соревнования включают в себя только дисциплины, на которых необходимо соблюдать тишину - 3х3х3 вслепую, 4х4х4 вслепую, 5х5х5 вслепую, 3х3х3 Мультиблайнд и 3х3х3 на количество ходов. Как следует из названия, чрезвычайно важно сохранять полную тишину во время всех дисциплин. У нас будет достаточное количество перерывов, во время которых можно будет пошуметь.

items.information:
* We will be giving out free Penn Cube Day tote bags for competitors.

* Current UPenn students are entitled to free registration. Please leave your Penn email in the registration comment and pay the fee. We will refund if you are qualified.

* We will have newcomer (competitors attending their first competition) podium for 3×3, based on the result of 3×3 round 1.

* We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. Missing your group risks potential disqualification from the event.

* Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants.

* Food and drinks are NOT permitted inside the main room. You may eat elsewhere in Houston Hall. There are a few restaurants within a ten minute walk/drive.

* Live results will be posted on WCA Live.

**Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh**

Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các đơn vị truyền thông có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Khi có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu.
________________________________________________________________

**Notice on photography and filming**
The organizers and/or media organizations may perform filming and photography at the competition for usage as photographic material of the competition. By being present at the competition premises,  **you acknowledge that you have been duly informed of any filming and photography that might take place at the competition, and fully acknowledge that the material may be used for any and all necessary purposes by the Vietnam Cube Association (VNCA) and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors. You also grant full, perpetual consent for VNCA and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors to use video and photographic material that contains your likeness and/or voice for any and all necessary purposes.** If you do not agree with the above terms, please do not be present at the competition premises.

items.information:
**(Português) Brasileiro**

Sejam todos bem-vindos à mais uma competição Capivara em parceria com o Colégio SEB Dom Bosco!

Esta é uma edição muito especial, em homenagem ao Mês da Mulher. Para celebrar essa data tão importante, teremos pódios femininos em todas as modalidades, incluindo a categoria iniciante.
Chamem suas amigas e venham comemorar conosco esse momento de reconhecimento e valorização!

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=OQ1vLrsJVqagiDna).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, pois penalidades serão aplicadas rigorosamente de acordo com ele. O regulamento pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).


**English**

Welcome to one other Capivara competition in partnership with *Colégio SEB Dom Bosco*!

This is a very special edition, held in honor of Women’s Month. To celebrate this important occasion, we will have female podiums in all event categories, including the beginner category.
Invite your friends and come celebrate this meaningful and empowering moment with us!

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=Sq18haJ3WPk2AG82).

It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

#### 🌻 Bienvenidos a Baja Spring 2026 🌻  

La cuarta edición de los icónicos **Baja Spring** llega este marzo para dar inicio a la primavera con una competencia llena de emoción y retos.  

Disfruta de las **categorías completas de NxN**  mas **3x3 a ciegas**.

Esta es una competencia avalada por la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**

items.name: Help Danelia Cubing Kazakhstan 2026

venue.name: Altyn Trading House
venue.details: Hall on the 3rd floor of the building

items.information:
Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында ұйымдастырылады. Жарыстан жиналған барлық қаражат туа біткен екіжақты құлақ атрезиясы мен микротия диагнозы қойылған Данелияның еміне бағытталады.
Данелия дерлік естімейді, сөйлеуі қиын, бұл оның жалпы дамуына әсер етуде. Қазіргі таңда ол сүйек өткізгіштігі бар есту аппаратын қолданады, алайда ол жиі бұзылып, баланың белсенді өміріне төтеп бере алмайды. Биыл Данелия 5 жасқа толады, және медициналық көрсеткіштер бойынша оған бас сүйегіне имплантация немесе каналопластика операциясы қажет.
АҚШ дәрігері ұсынған каналопластика операциясы Данелияның есту қабілетін қалпына келтіріп, есту жолын кеңейтуге және өмір бойы есту аппаратына тәуелді болмауға мүмкіндік беруі мүмкін.
Жиналған қаражат тікелей қолма-қол берілмейді. Барлық жарналар ресми түрде «ZHALAIRI» қайырымдылық қоры арқылы қабылданып, Данелияның еміне заңды және ашық түрде бағытталады.
Жарыс  Алтын сауда орталығында ,3 қабаттары  холлда өтеді.
Сіздің қолдауыңыз Данелияға толыққанды өмір сүруге үлкен үміт сыйлайды.
Баршаңызды қайырымдылық жарысына қатысуға және қолдау көрсетуге шақырамыз

English:
The competition is organized for charitable purposes. All funds raised during the event will be directed toward the treatment of Danelia, who has been diagnosed with congenital bilateral ear atresia and microtia.
Danelia can barely hear and has difficulty speaking, which affects her overall development. Currently, she uses a bone-conduction hearing device; however, it frequently breaks down and cannot withstand an active child’s lifestyle. This year, Danelia turns 5 years old, and according to medical indications, she requires either a skull implantation procedure or canaloplasty surgery.
The canaloplasty surgery recommended by a U.S. doctor may help restore Danelia’s hearing, widen the ear canal, and allow her to live without lifelong dependence on a hearing device.
The collected funds will not be handed directly in cash. All donations will be officially received through the «ZHALAIRI» charitable foundation and will be legally and transparently allocated to Danelia’s treatment.
The competition will take place at Altyn Shopping Center, 3rd floor hall.
Your support gives Danelia great hope for a full and happy life.
We invite everyone to participate in the charity competition and show their support.

The iguanas are back in the sun. A year later, Vallarta Speed returns to the scene and announces a new tournament at home, this time as an NxN event. The event will take place in Nuevo Vallarta, Nayarit, on March 7th and 8th, 2026, for cube solving, camaraderie, and an amazing time.

This is an NxN challenge, with categories ranging from 2x2 to 7x7 and OH, where speed, concentration, and endurance will be put to the test.

This competition is organized by the Vallarta Speed community.

This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association (WCA) event. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA Rules](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by  [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
